peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: SILVER 71.6% with 3/3 replicate support; COPPER 16.4% with 3/3 replicate support; BTC 12.1% with 2/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: Silver
peers.reason: Direct precious-metal substitute and the dominant return comparator; it shares gold's monetary, inflation-hedge, real-rate, dollar, and safe-haven exposure, so it receives most of the weight.

peers.name: Copper
peers.reason: Copper is a directly traded metal rather than a corporate or leveraged wrapper, and it shares part of Gold's macro pricing channel through the US dollar, inflation expectations, and mining or input-cost conditions. The weight is much smaller because copper's return is driven mainly by industrial growth and construction or manufacturing demand, not by the monetary safe-haven demand that defines Gold.

peers.name: Bitcoin
peers.reason: A major non-sovereign store-of-value alternative often compared with gold as digital gold; it overlaps on real-yield, dollar-liquidity, and debasement narratives but has separate crypto risk, so it gets a meaningful but smaller weight.

primary_index_hedge.name: Silver
primary_index_hedge.reason: Silver is the closest other traded precious metal and shares gold's dominant drivers: real yields, the US dollar, inflation expectations, and safe-haven or debasement demand. Hedging gold with silver neutralizes the monetary-metals factor while leaving the smaller gold-versus-silver basis.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
